label: Romuleo
summary: Either an anatomical text in the circle of Gabriele Zerbi, or the Romuleon, a history of Rome.

value.text: no. 107, Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany

claims.statement: Entered as no. 107 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "Romuleo".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Romuleon / Liber Anathomiae. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
